race.comment: CAMERINA (8) is racing well with four top-five finishes in succession, the latest effort a second at this track over 1660m. Drawn to enjoy an economical run and might sweat on the sprint lane. Perfectly placed and is sure to prove tough to beat again. BLACKJACK NZ (10) has been competitive of late and kept the ball rolling last time when a nose from the winner in second over 1660m at this track. Will need an ounce of luck to slot in from this tricky draw. Good enough to take out a race like this. FRANCO NOT OUT NZ (4) is back from a let-up but has some solid trial under the belt. Go well. READY TO DREAM NZ (5) will be cherry-ripe after four runs back from a spell, the latest effort a ninth at Canberra three-and-a-half weeks ago.
